label: TheWaypoints
releaseNotes: 0.97 Beta 1: Compact yellow distance labels beside POI names, separate type/address/coordinates, natural street and city addresses, gold saved stars and clearer Favorites empty states. Search fields have margins; scrolling dismisses the keyboard. Sidebar selection is bright yellow with boxier items. Region guidance is a full-width clickable row with an inline arrow; disabled bottom buttons are opaque. Existing favorites and downloaded packs are preserved. Based on the original Waypoints idea and codebase by Vadim Sinitskiy.
